topic: Day 26 — carousel — Your relationship settles wherever your standard meets their effort

slides.text: Wherever your standard meets their effort, exactly there.
It's an equilibrium shaped by both people's thresholds.
Change your threshold and the whole system shifts.

caption:
Every relationship settles at the intersection of your standards and their effort. Raise one side and the whole equilibrium shifts.

Follow for one of these a day.
